payload.body_you: You and {{holder2}} tend to think at the same speed and follow the same jumps in conversation. You may finish each other's sentences, pick up an old discussion without needing context, or build an idea together so quickly that neither remembers where it began. That familiarity can feel deeply validating. It can also blur the difference between agreement and shared habit. After enough time, you and {{holder2}} may assume you reached the same conclusion when neither person actually stopped to explain what they meant.
